title: Genome-wide identification and in-silico characterization of phytopathogenic Taf14 gene in Fusarium oxysporum fungus, and fungicide repurposing.
authors: Naim, Md Darun; Imtiaj, Ahmed; Mollah, Md Nurul Haque
one_liner_zh: 该研究对尖孢镰刀菌Taf14基因进行全基因组鉴定与表征，并通过分子对接筛选杀菌剂，虽涉及蛋白-DNA相关因子但未聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，方法以序列分析和简单对接为主，与课题核心关联有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Phytopathogenic fungi cause global agricultural damage of around 40%, for which there is an economic loss of more than $200 billion annually. F. oxysporum is one of the top five phytopathogenic fungi worldwide, which is extremely resistant to high temperatures and antiseptic chemicals. Therefore, it is crucial to find alternative fungicides against the F. oxysporum (Fo) pathogenic fungus in order to increase crop yields. The TATA box-binding protein (TBP)-associated factor 14 (Taf14) gene in Botrytis cinerea represented by (BcTaf14) is considered as the disease-causing gene in crops. Therefore, Taf14 protein has been recommended as the potential receptor to explore effective fungicides against the corresponding diseases in crops. However, the Taf14 gene in F. oxysporum is not yet identified and characterized. OBJECTIVES: The specific objectives of this study are to (i) identify and characterize F. oxysporum Taf14 (FoTaf14) gene as the Fusarium wilt disease causing gene in crops, and (ii) exploring FoTaf14 gene guided candidate fungicides against the diseases in crops. METHODS: This study identified FoTaf14 proteins from the whole proteome of F. oxysporum by using BcTaf14 as the query protein in BLASTP search. The integrated bioinformatics studies including phylogenetic tree, domain analysis, subcellular location, pathway terms, regulatory elements and expression analysis were performed in order to characterize FoTaf14 proteins. Then we explored FoTaf14 proteins guided candidate fungicides against the Fusarium wilt disease in crops by molecular docking analysis. RESULTS: The phylogenetic tree has shown that FoTaf14 and Taf14 from other fungal divisions are similar. The YEATS domain has been detected by domain analysis as having a direct impact on fungal pathogenicity. The subcellular location analysis revealed that all FoTaf14s are found in the nucleus and cytoplasm, which are directly related to fungal growth and pathogenicity. The gene ontology (GO) enrichment analysis has revealed some important GO-terms that are related to plant diseases. The cis-regulatory network analysis of FoTaf14 genes has shown that C-box, MYB, ABRE, SEF4, and TAAAG motifs are associated with stress, growth, and development, whereas GATA box, GT-1 motif, SEBF, HD, and W box are associated with virulence. Expression analysis has shown that FoTaf14 genes are highly expressed in the pathogenicity, growth, and development of F. oxysporum. Finally, we detected FoTaf14-protein-guided three repurposed fungicides (Oxathiapiprolin, Tolfenpyrad and Amisulbrom) for the treatment against the Fusarium wilt disease in crops by molecular docking analysis. CONCLUSION: Therefore, the findings of this study might be useful resources for taking a proper treatment plan against Fusarium wilt disease to increase quality crop production.
abstract_zh: 背景：植物病原真菌造成全球农业损失约40%，每年经济损失超过2000亿美元。尖孢镰刀菌（F. oxysporum）是全球五大植物病原真菌之一，对高温和防腐化学品具有极强的抗性。因此，寻找针对尖孢镰刀菌（Fo）病原真菌的替代杀菌剂以提高作物产量至关重要。灰葡萄孢（Botrytis cinerea）中由BcTaf14代表的TATA盒结合蛋白（TBP）相关因子14（Taf14）基因被认为是作物致病基因。因此，Taf14蛋白已被推荐为探索针对作物相应病害的有效杀菌剂的潜在受体。然而，尖孢镰刀菌中的Taf14基因尚未被鉴定和表征。目标：本研究的具体目标是（i）鉴定和表征尖孢镰刀菌Taf14（FoTaf14）基因作为作物枯萎病的致病基因，以及（ii）探索FoTaf14基因引导的候选杀菌剂以防治作物病害。方法：本研究通过使用BcTaf14作为查询蛋白进行BLASTP搜索，从尖孢镰刀菌的全蛋白质组中鉴定FoTaf14蛋白。进行了整合生物信息学研究，包括系统发育树、结构域分析、亚细胞定位、通路术语、调控元件和表达分析，以表征FoTaf14蛋白。随后，通过分子对接分析探索了FoTaf14蛋白引导的候选杀菌剂以防治作物枯萎病。结果：系统发育树显示，FoTaf14与其他真菌门类的Taf14相似。结构域分析检测到YEATS结构域对真菌致病性有直接影响。亚细胞定位分析揭示所有FoTaf14均存在于细胞核和细胞质中，这与真菌生长和致病性直接相关。基因本体（GO）富集分析揭示了一些与植物病害相关的重要GO术语。FoTaf14基因的顺式调控网络分析显示，C-box、MYB、ABRE、SEF4和TAAAG基序与胁迫、生长和发育相关，而GATA box、GT-1基序、SEBF、HD和W box与毒力相关。表达分析显示，FoTaf14基因在尖孢镰刀菌的致病性、生长和发育中高表达。最后，通过分子对接分析，我们检测到FoTaf14蛋白引导的三种再利用杀菌剂（Oxathiapiprolin、Tolfenpyrad和Amisulbrom）用于治疗作物枯萎病。结论：因此，本研究的发现可能为制定针对枯萎病的适当治疗计划以提高作物质量产量提供有用资源。
